text.tspan: Experience of Christ — As the Good Land
My entertainment is the church; all the dear saints, my family.
Here gladly I will spend my all; grace is sufficient and will increase.
O Jesus, Jesus, fill me up every moment,
Let me enjoy Your lovely self so sweet as my complete supply.
O Jesus, Jesus, fill me up every moment,
Let me enjoy Your lovely self so sweet as my complete supply.
If there’s “church life” without the cross, it’s false—reject it utterly.
The old creation we cast off; divine life sprouts, transforming our being.
O Jesus Jesus, illumine me continually.
Let me be lost in Thee, O holy Light, from all sin’s bondage set free.
Give strength, new life, releasing me from anxiety.
Let me enjoy Your lovely self so sweet, as my complete supply.
